chunks: And whatever is in it from Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq al-Nahdi, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn ʿAtiyyah, from Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah,
and the name of Abi Fakhtah was Saʿid ibn ʿAlaqah.

key_terms.اسْمُ أَبِي فَاخِتَةَ: The identification of Abi Fakhtah by his personal name.
key_terms.ثُوَيْرِ بْنِ أَبِي فَاخِتَةَ: A narrator whose transmission path is being clarified here.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating receipt and reporting of hadith.
key_terms.سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَلَاقَةَ: The personal name of Abi Fakhtah mentioned for biographical clarification.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which reports from Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah are transmitted in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It also identifies Abi Fakhtah by name as Saʿid ibn ʿAlaqah, making the entry both a transmission note and a brief biographical clarification.
